items.q: Does the point (2, 5) lie inside, on, or outside the circle x² + y² = 25?
items.qAf: Lê die punt (2, 5) binne, op, of buite die sirkel x² + y² = 25?
items.explain: 2² + 5² = 29 is greater than 25, so the point lies outside the circle.
items.explainAf: 2² + 5² = 29 is groter as 25, dus lê die punt buite die sirkel.

items.q: The point (3, 4) lies on x² + y² = 25. What is the gradient of the tangent at this point?
items.qAf: Die punt (3, 4) lê op x² + y² = 25. Wat is die gradiënt van die raaklyn by hierdie punt?
items.explain: The radius has gradient 4/3, and the tangent is perpendicular to it, so its gradient is −3/4.
items.explainAf: Die radius het gradiënt 4/3, en die raaklyn is loodreg daarop, dus is die gradiënt −3/4.

items.q: Find the equation of the tangent to x² + y² = 25 at (3, 4).
items.qAf: Vind die vergelyking van die raaklyn aan x² + y² = 25 by (3, 4).

items.q: The line y = x + k is a tangent to x² + y² = 8. Determine k.
items.qAf: Die lyn y = x + k is ’n raaklyn aan x² + y² = 8. Bepaal k.
items.explain: The distance from (0, 0) to x − y + k = 0 is |k| ÷ √2 = √8, so |k| = 4.
items.explainAf: Die afstand vanaf (0, 0) tot x − y + k = 0 is |k| ÷ √2 = √8, dus |k| = 4.
